bug_summary: In the "message"-handling branch of ThrowableDeserializer.deserializeFromObject, the Throwable is now only instantiated when none exists yet, instead of always being re-created from the "message" value. When an any-setter property (or a repeated "message" entry) is seen before "message", the pre-existing instance is kept and the JSON "message" value is silently dropped, so the returned exception can end up with a null message even though the input carried one; with duplicate "message" entries the first value now wins instead of the last.
